title: Adaptive SLO Observability Catalog and Token Latency Explorer
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Background: We need a consolidated observability surface that catalogs golden signals and exposes token-level latency SLIs in a developer-friendly explorer. Current dashboards are fragmented by team and region, making triage slow during cross-region degradations. Goal: build an Observability Catalog (central metadata index for metrics and dashboards), implement a Token Latency Explorer (interactive UI to query token-level SLI cohorts and p50/p95/p99 breakdowns by model, region, and sequence-length tier), and wire the outputs into our failover/circuit orchestrator for automated experiments.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Observability Catalog API returns standardized metadata for 30+ golden signals and correlates dashboards across regions. 2) Token Latency Explorer UI allows selecting model, region, priority bucket, and sequence-length cohort and shows token-level p50/p95/p99 with KV/cache hit overlays. 3) Explorer supports drilldown to request traces and links to associated incident runbooks. 4) Dashboards instrumented with quantile-aware aggregation and synthetic prober alignment. 5) Integration with canary admission controller: explorer provides an API that returns admit score distributions for decisioning experiments.
success_metrics: 1) Mean time to detect (MTTD) multi-region degradations reduced from 18m to <6m. 2) Mean time to diagnose (MTTDx) reduced by 35%. 3) Number of outages where token-latency cohorts helped root-cause increases to >60% of incidents. 4) Usage: 80% of SRE/Runtime oncall open explorer at incident start.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: High-cardinality queries at token level can overwhelm metrics store. Mitigation: use sampled telemetry + pre-aggregated cohort rollups and a synthetic prober for cold-starts. Risk: exposing too many internals to product dashboards. Mitigation: catalog enforces stable metric names and a metadata layer with RBAC. Risk: Dependence on KV-prefetch instrumentation not yet available in all regions. Mitigation: show "kv-prefetch: unknown" and fall back to sequence-cohort heuristics.
work_breakdown: 1) Schema: define metric metadata format and standardize golden signal tags (2d). 2) Instrumentation: add token-level labels (model, region, seq_len_bucket, priority) to prober (3d). 3) Aggregation: implement quantile rollups and cohort sampling pipeline (4d). 4) Backend API: catalog + explorer query endpoints (3d). 5) UI: Explorer canvas + dashboard links (4d). 6) Integration tests and chaos rehearsal across 2 regions (3d). 7) Rollout: staged in prod via feature flag and limited to runtime-1.24 clusters (2d).
